text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COAL - Queensland, Oct 28 - Abbot Point - berth vacant, 7 vessels due by 23/11. No delays. Dalrymple Bay - two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 19 due by 20/11, 1 days delay. Maintenance shutdown 4/11 to 9/11. Hay Point - two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 4 due by 5/11. Approx 1-2 days delay. Gladstone - Gordonstone mine on 7 day strike 24/10 to 31/11 due to local dispute. Oaky creek mine on indefinite stoppage due to local issues. R.G. Tanna 1 vessel loading, 2 waiting, 30 due by 20/12. Approx 1-2 days delay. Barney Point berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 26/11. No delays. Major shutdown to upgrade plant and equipment being carried out. First vessel scheduled to load on 10/11. Brisbane - berth vacant 5 Vessels due by 23/11 No delays.

New South Wales - Newcastle - Kooragang 2 vessels loading, 2 waiting, 14 due by 8/11. Approx 1-2 days delay. Dyke 4+5 1 loading 1 waiting 14 due by 10/11. 1-2 Days delay. Port Kembla - one vessel loading, 2 waiting, 18 due by 4/12. 1-2 Days delay.

IRON ORE - Western Australia - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) A berth 9 vessels due by 7/11. B berth 7 due by 5/11. 2 other vessels due with no eta. Goldsworthy Finucane Island 1 vessel loading, 1 due 4/11. Dampier - Parker Point one loading, 3 anchored, 1 due 28/10. E.I. Island 1 vessel loading, 2 anchored, 1 due 29/10. Dampier lineup 11 vessels due. Port Walcott - one vessel loading, 9 due by 15/11.

GRAIN - Queensland - Mackay - two wheat vessels due by 14/11. No further grain shipments expected until March 1997 due to maintenance and overhaul of storage and handling facilities. Gladstone - one vessel loading wheat, 4 wheat vessels due by 15/11. Brisbane - four wheat vessels due by 14/11.

New South Wales - Newcastle - one vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel due 15/11. Port Kembla - two wheat vessels due by 8/11. 5 others due in year. Victoria, Geelong - one wheat vessel due 14/11. No shipping at Geelong 22/11-9/12 due maintenance and belt repairs. Portland - one vessel loading wheat.

South Australia - Port Pirie - two wheat vessels due by 4/11. Port Adelaide - one loading barley, 1 wheat vessel due 7/11. Thevenard - no vessels due. Port Lincoln - two wheat due by 3/11. Wallaroo, Ardrossan, Port Giles - no vessels due.
Western Australia - Geraldton - three vessels due by 11/11. Kwinana - two vessels loading wheat, 6 due by 8/11. Albany two wheat vessels due by 14/11. Esperance - no vessels due.
